project_type: Python monorepo — FastAPI API, Temporal worker (Python SDK), Next.js 14 dashboard, synthetiq-shared package
build_system: No top-level build script. Each package has its own environment. Worker uses standard Python imports with PYTHONPATH. API uses FastAPI/uvicorn. Dashboard uses Next.js (read node_modules/next/dist/docs/ before editing any TSX).
test_framework: pytest (worker: cd worker && python -m pytest, API: cd api && python -m pytest). No dashboard test runner confirmed.
build_command: cd worker && python -c 'from src.flows.workflows import MasterEPRComplianceWorkflow' (smoke-import check). API: cd api && python -c 'from src.main import app'.
test_command: cd worker && python -m pytest tests/ -x -q  |  cd api && python -m pytest tests/ -x -q
verification_instructions: 1) For each changed Python file run a smoke import: cd worker && python -c 'from <module> import <name>'. 2) For workflow changes confirm MasterEPRComplianceWorkflow imports clean. 3) For dashboard change: cd dashboard && npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | Select-String 'agents/page'.
environment_constraints: Windows/PowerShell workspace. The dashboard AGENTS.md rule says to read node_modules/next/dist/docs/ before writing any Next.js code — this applies to agents/page.tsx. Do NOT restart any dev servers.
contribution_requirements: No AGENTS.md or CONTRIBUTING.md at repo root. Dashboard has AGENTS.md injected by next dev that requires reading Next.js docs from node_modules before editing TSX files.
key_patterns: 1) Agent files use `create_llm_agent(name=..., instruction=..., tools=[...], description=..., output_key=...)` from `.base_adk`. 2) Activities use @activity.defn and return typed Pydantic model dicts. 3) Workflows import activities inside `with workflow.unsafe.imports_passed_through()` block. 4) DB access uses `async with get_db_session() as session`. 5) All agent runner functions are `async def run_*_agent(...)` that call `run_agent(agent=..., ...)` from base_adk.
directory_structure: c:/Users/HP/SynthetIQ/ — monorepo root. worker/src/activities/ — Temporal activity functions. worker/src/flows/ — Temporal workflow definitions. worker/src/agents/ — 7 ADK LlmAgent files + base_adk.py. worker/src/factories/ — NEW: per-run agent factory (to create). worker/src/services/ — ai_service.py, scheduler_service.py, jev_auditor, nimble_service, etc. api/src/routes/ — FastAPI routers. packages/synthetiq-shared/synthetiq_shared/ — shared ORM models, seed data, constants. dashboard/app/ — Next.js App Router pages.
